name: microWakeWord
author: hassmic
description: The open wake word engine of ESPHome's voice satellites, with models you add. It hears the wake word less reliably than Amazon's engine.

settings.name: models
settings.label: Wake word models
settings.help: microWakeWord's models: a .tflite file each, with the .json manifest of the same name if you have it (the wake word's name, its threshold). ESPHome's own are one click below.

fields.name: cutoff
fields.label: Threshold (lower hears more, and more by mistake)

fields.name: window
fields.label: Window (30 ms steps the threshold must hold over)
